plain: A naval officer ranking above a captain.

webster.text: The officer who commands a squadron or detachment of ships, destined on a particular enterprise.

example.quote: The commodore hoped the gentleman who had approved of our state Constitution of 1778, would be, in time, equally pleased with the Federal Constitution proposed in 1787.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 4, South Carolina House of Representatives (debate on calling the convention), Hon. ROBERT BARNWELL, January 17, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
